title: NationalVariable set
description: Per-country reference values that formula-valued requirements peg to (e.g. Germany's pension contribution ceiling, which Blue Card salary thresholds are a percentage of). One file per country. Storing the value once here means an annual update corrects every dependent route automatically, instead of hand-editing each route file. First proposed in schema-v1.md / stress-test-2 (Portugal D7 minimum-wage case), first implemented for Germany's EU Blue Card.

variables.description: Keyed by variable id (referenced from requirement.value.formula_ref in route files).

update_cadence.description: e.g. 'annual_january', 'annual_march' — when this figure typically re-baselines, used to flag routes for re-verification
